note: The SOLIT2 test gallery AS TESTED. This is the standard, not a project. Annex 2 section 2 'Test Tunnel' (p.5) states the geometry outright: 'The tunnel has a length of 600 m with a slope of 1%. The width of the original tunnel is 9,5 m with a height of 8,20 m. To perform fire tests with semi-transversal ventilation and to protect the tunnel, some modifications were made prior to the test program. Over a length of 450 m a suspended ceiling with a height of 5,20 m was installed. Furthermore, in the surrounding of the fire area, additional walls were installed to provide a tunnel with of 7,50 m.' THIS IS A MODIFIED SECTION, NOT A NATURAL BORE: the 5.20 m height is a SUSPENDED CEILING over 450 m of a tunnel that is 8.20 m high underneath it, and the 7.50 m width comes from WALLS ADDED around the fire area inside a bore that is 9.5 m wide. The as-tested cross-section is therefore 7.50 x 5.20 m, 39.0 m2, which is what the c4/c5/c6 reference cases were measured in. This preset previously carried 9.5 m x 5.17 m / 48 m2: the 9.5 m was the ORIGINAL unmodified width and the 5.17 m matched nothing in Annex 2. clearance_m 4.5 is NOT stated anywhere in Annex 2 and is unverified against the source. Also from the same Annex 2 section, and not representable in this schema: the tunnel has 6 jet fans giving a maximum longitudinal air velocity of 6.5 m/s, and its semi-transversal system 'is designed to deal with free burning fires of approx. 30 MW'. Annex 7 5.2.6 puts the fire target 5 m downstream of the mock-up, of the same width, height and combustibility. Annex 7 5.2.7 mandates that BOTH 1.5 m/s and 3.0 m/s longitudinal velocity be tested, measured 45 m upstream of the fire -- a velocity range is a property of the TEST, not of the tunnel, so it is not carried here: see the designs under examples/designs/, which set ventilation.velocity_range_ms to [1.5, 3.0] so the envelope actually runs both. These are TEST conditions, not site conditions; Annex 7 3.3 governs transferring results between them.
